overview_description.description:
Homejoy believes everyone deserves a happy home. With just a few clicks, Homejoy’s online platform will match you with a screened, background-checked and certified professional cleaner who maintains high customer ratings. And at $20/hour, Homejoy makes a sparkling home an affordable reality for everyone. 

Founded in 2010 by brother-sister duo Aaron and Adora Cheung, the San Francisco-based company serves 31 markets in North America and growing. 

For additional information on Homejoy, please visit www.homejoy.com/about or www.homejoy.com/press.
